process_index.label: PROFILE-BOUND OPERATOR PROCESS INDEX
process_index.aggregation: equal-weight mean of the six construct estimates
process_index.issued_only_when: every construct in construct_ids has an issued operator_process estimate

outcome_domains.aggregation: equal-weight mean of the four domain estimates, each of which is the equal-weight mean of its required cells
outcome_domains.issued_only_when: every domain has an issued estimate, which requires every cell it names to be issued
outcome_domains.note: The system-outcome axis is read in four domains rather than by construct: an outcome is what the delegated work produced, and the constructs that produced it are the operator's. The grouping lives here because this artifact is where a cell's meaning is declared; a consumer that grouped these cells for itself would be a second mapping of the same cells.

longitudinal_lane.note: Not summed into the process index, the outcome profile, or any composite. Transfer evidence does not raise a short-cycle number.

constructs.title: Framing & Contracting
constructs.definition: Defines the goal, constraints, non-goals, acceptance evidence, and stop condition before delegation.

constructs.title: Context, Decomposition & Delegation
constructs.definition: Selects evidence, decomposes work, chooses routes, allocates authority, and controls dependencies.

constructs.title: Monitoring & Reliance Calibration
constructs.definition: Decides when to rely on AI, when to rely on self, inspects evidence, and calibrates confidence to correctness.

constructs.title: Steering, Intervention & Recovery
constructs.definition: Diagnoses problems, changes instructions or routes, stops unsafe continuation, and resumes from the correct state.

constructs.title: Verification & Epistemic Governance
constructs.definition: Requires independent checks, binds conclusions to exact evidence and revision, and rejects unsupported completion.

constructs.title: Safety, Boundary & Resource Governance
constructs.definition: Applies least privilege, respects execution boundaries, controls external actions, and manages cost and resource risk.

constructs.title: Learning & Transfer
constructs.definition: Retains and transfers what the collaboration produced to work attempted without the agent.
